newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Islamists held after anti-Israel protest.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Islamists held after anti-Israel protest.

text.p: Turkish police detained six radical Islamists on Friday after about one thousand people protested in Istanbul against the killing of over 50 Palestinians by Israeli forces this week, witnesses said.
Protesters burnt an Israeli flag and chanted anti-Jewish and anti-American slogans after pouring out of a historical mosque into a central Istanbul square following Friday prayers.

Some 450 riot police ringed the square and after the protest took into custody the ringleaders, six prominent members of the radical Aczimendi group, who led the protest in their traditional Islamic dress.
"The hands of the Jews who touched the holy place will be broken," one of the protesters shouted at the crowd that held up banners adorned with Islamic refrains.
The protest ended peacefully after police requests.
Earlier this year, Moslem but secular Turkey signed a military training accord with Israel that caused widespread anger in the Moslem world.
